outputs.discrepancies: Panel B's spectrum shows minor mass-shifted peaks (~+110 Da and ~+238 Da relative to the apo mass, together ~12% of total intensity) that are numerically consistent with low levels of 1- and 2-Cd adducts (matching the small PacL1Δ⁵+1Cd/+2Cd fractions shown in panel C). This is a minor nuance relative to the caption's blanket statement that Cd does not bind PacL1Δ⁵, though the overwhelming majority (~88%) of the protein remains unbound, consistent with the qualitative claim of much weaker/negligible binding compared to panel A.
